title: block id scalars
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkBlockIdScalars by creating a recursive multi-block dataset of image data blocks, assigning block-id scalars, and visualizing each block with a different color.

**input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkBlockIdScalars](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBlockIdScalars.html) — block id scalars.
- [vtkCompositePolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCompositePolyDataMapper.html) — maps composite (multi-block) polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetSurfaceFilter.html) — data set surface filter.
- [vtkImageData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageData.html) — represents a regular grid of points (image/volume).
- [vtkMultiBlockDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMultiBlockDataSet.html) — groups multiple datasets into a composite structure.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
